manualCreate.title: Manual Create
manualCreate.subtitle: Build your AI persona step by step, with full control over every detail.

basic.name: Name
basic.personalityHint: Outgoing, gentle, tsundere, cool, sarcastic, healing...
basic.relationshipPurposeHint: Daily chat / venting / companionship / deep connection...

style.tip: Think of a character you know — like "talks like Tyrion from Game of Thrones". This makes the persona's voice concrete and recognizable.
style.speechStyleHint: Sarcastic intellectual, gentle big-sister type, literary romantic, anime-style...
style.referenceHint: e.g.: Chandler Bing, Luna Lovegood, Tony Stark, Elizabeth Bennet...
style.detailsHint: Specific traits: catchphrases, filler words, sentence patterns...
style.conflictStyleHint: How do they talk when upset? Passive-aggressive? Direct blowup? Silent treatment?

boundary.tip: Boundaries define the persona's sense of security and tolerance in relationships — do they get anxious when ignored? Do they go cold when criticized?
boundary.attachmentQ: If you disappeared for 3 days, how should they react?
boundary.attachmentPlaceholder:
A. Completely unfazed, waits for you
B. Sends one message then ghosts too
C. Says it's fine but secretly cares
D. Blows up your phone asking where you were
(Or describe in your own words)
boundary.conflictQ: If you said "It's none of your business", how should they react?
boundary.conflictPlaceholder: Describe the expected reaction: snap back? Silent treatment? Get hurt? Laugh it off?
boundary.initiativeQ: Should they reach out proactively? How often?
boundary.initiativePlaceholder: e.g.: Every day / every few days / never, waits for you / depends on mood...

attachment.tip: Attachment is the emotional core — high anxiety means fear of abandonment, high avoidance means fear of intimacy. These two dimensions combine into infinite personality variations.
attachment.anxietyHint: Higher = more fear of abandonment. 0.8 = extremely insecure, 0.2 = very independent
attachment.avoidanceHint: Higher = more resistance to intimacy. 0.8 = fears closeness, 0.2 = very clingy
attachment.selfEsteemHint: Higher = less affected by others' judgment. 0.8 = inner strength, 0.2 = fragile
attachment.initiativeHint: Higher = reaches out more often. 0.8 = messages daily, 0.2 = always waits for you
attachment.trustMediumDesc: Needs a few days to cool down
attachment.trustSlowDesc: Holds grudges, hard to truly forgive

system.typingOverridesHint: e.g.: Sends all at once when angry / one at a time when happy / no splits during serious talks...
system.typingSpeedHint: Fantasy characters can be extremely fast (e.g., "telepathic" → 999)
system.fragmentationHint: 0 = sends as one block (like an email) → 1 = heavily fragmented (one sentence at a time, like texting)
system.imageDesc: Persona can send photos (requires image API key)
system.appearanceHint: Long black hair, blue eyes, 17-year-old student, 165cm...
system.imageStyleHint: anime style, soft lighting / photorealistic, warm tones...
system.advancedWarning: Big Five defaults are derived from your selections above. Only adjust if you understand each dimension.

socialRhythmOptions.slow_warm_desc: Doesn't reply instantly, but always sincere when they do
socialRhythmOptions.fast_excited_desc: Instant replies, once they start they can't stop
socialRhythmOptions.irregular_desc: No fixed pattern, replies on a whim

conflictStyleOptions.direct_confront_desc: Says it when upset, but leaves the door open
conflictStyleOptions.cold_shoulder_desc: Says it's fine but stews inside, needs reassurance
conflictStyleOptions.escape_desc: Flees from conflict, pretends nothing happened

typingStyleOptions.fragmented_desc: Sends one line at a time, like texting
typingStyleOptions.composed_desc: Sends full paragraphs, like writing a letter
typingStyleOptions.mixed_desc: Usually fragmented, but composed for important moments

relationshipPhaseOptions.stranger_desc: First contact today, cautious and confused
relationshipPhaseOptions.acquaintance_desc: Chatted a few times, knows who they are, basic goodwill
relationshipPhaseOptions.friend_desc: Mutual trust, shares daily life naturally
relationshipPhaseOptions.close_friend_desc: No filters, no masks, complete trust

archive.tip: A life archive gives the persona a past — childhood, family, pivotal experiences. These memories enrich conversations and add depth.
archive.currentContextHint: Describe their current situation: occupation, location, daily rhythm, current stressors...
archive.autoFooter: You can edit the full archive after creation

confirm.tip: Review the persona configuration, then confirm to create.
confirm.sampleDesc: Disable to write custom sample dialogues
confirm.sampleJsonHint: Advanced: edit JSON structure directly, each segment is one object

personaDetail.qqInvalid: Enter a QQ number with 5 to 15 digits.
personaDetail.qqBindingHint: The persona QQ logs in to NapCat. Owner QQ limits replies to your private messages.
personaDetail.qqIncomplete: Configure both the persona and owner QQ numbers before checking message routing.
personaDetail.qqTitle: QQ account the persona logs in with (NapCat scan)
personaDetail.testChatExpandedDesc: Send a test message to see how {name} would reply
personaDetail.testChatSent: Message sent to {name}. The persona is thinking... (actual reply will arrive via QQ or message queue)
personaDetail.testChatSentToast: Message sent. The reply will arrive through the configured channel.
personaDetail.phaseAcquaintanceDesc: Chatted a few times, basic goodwill

settings.title: Settings
settings.imageUnconfigured: Not configured. Without this, the persona won't send images.
settings.channelDesc: Your QQ account (main). All personas will only reply to messages from this number.
settings.qqStep1Desc: Register a separate QQ account for the persona.
settings.qqStep2Desc: Download and start NapCat, scan QR to log in as the persona's account.
settings.qqStep3Desc: In NapCat WebUI, set up reverse WebSocket
settings.qqStep4Desc: Enter your main QQ above. The persona will only reply to you.
